zh-TW.title: 生日派對佈置
zh-TW.headline: 讓生日主角，站在故事中央。
zh-TW.description: 香港生日會佈置從主題、氣球色調到蛋糕桌一起規劃。BoboParty 協助你按家居、餐廳或會所空間安排拍照背景，為小朋友生日與成人聚會留下有個性的畫面。

sections.title: 先由主角的喜好開始
sections.text: 選擇一個喜歡的顏色、興趣或故事作為起點，再延伸到氣球、桌面與背景的配搭。小朋友生日會可考慮拍照時的身高與活動空間；成人生日聚會則可用較簡潔的色調，把焦點留給主角和蛋糕。

sections.title: 按香港場地安排佈置
sections.text: 家居派對可集中佈置一面牆或蛋糕桌，避免裝飾阻礙通道。餐廳及會所生日會則應先確認牆身固定限制、升降機尺寸和進場時段，讓背景尺寸與現場條件配合。

sections.title: 查詢前準備甚麼
sections.text: 提供生日日期、場地相片、預計人數、主角年齡和參考色調，能幫助我們討論合適方向。報價需要按尺寸、物料、運送及安裝安排確認，不同參考圖片未必適合直接套用。

faqs.question: 小型家居生日會也可以做佈置嗎？
faqs.answer: 可以先討論蛋糕桌或小型拍照角落，並提供可用牆身的闊度、高度及相片，讓設計配合空間。

faqs.question: 應該先訂場地還是先選主題？
faqs.answer: 可先整理喜歡的主題，但建議確認場地限制和進場時間後，再落實背景尺寸與安裝方案。

en.title: Birthday party styling
en.headline: A birthday with your own personality.
en.description: Plan a birthday setting in Hong Kong around your theme, balloon palette and cake table. BoboParty helps you consider the space at home, a restaurant or a clubhouse for children’s birthdays and adult celebrations.

sections.title: Start with the person
sections.text: Choose a favourite colour, interest or story, then carry it through balloons, table details and the backdrop. For children, consider their height in photographs and space to move. For adults, a restrained palette can frame the cake and the guest of honour.

sections.title: Work with your venue
sections.text: At home, focus on one wall or a cake table and leave walkways clear. At a restaurant or clubhouse, check fixing restrictions, lift access and the setup window before deciding how large the backdrop should be.

sections.title: Prepare your enquiry
sections.text: Share the date, venue photographs, guest count, age and preferred colours. Pricing depends on dimensions, materials, delivery and installation. A reference image is a starting point; its proportions may need to change for your venue.

faqs.question: Can I decorate a small birthday at home?
faqs.answer: Start with a cake table or a small photo corner. Share the wall width, height and photographs so the design can fit the available space.

faqs.question: Should I book the venue or choose a theme first?
faqs.answer: Collect theme ideas early, but confirm venue restrictions and access times before finalising backdrop dimensions and installation.

zh-TW.title: 氣球佈置與背景牆訂製
zh-TW.headline: 用色彩，改變一個空間。
zh-TW.description: 香港氣球佈置與背景牆訂製，從主題設計、配色、名字文字到現場比例逐一規劃。參考 BoboParty 的設計圖與實景照片，按生日會、百日宴或品牌活動的場地條件，討論專屬背景與氣球配搭。

sections.title: 從設計圖到現場佈置
sections.text: 參考本頁六組設計與實景照片，了解主題圖案、背景板、人物立牌及氣球如何配合成完整場景。訂製可先從喜歡的主題、配色及文字開始，再按場地闊度、高度和動線調整；製作項目、物料與尺寸以確認方案為準。

sections.title: 配色與比例一起考慮
sections.text: 可從兩至三種主色開始，配合場地牆身、光線與桌布。高樓底空間和小型房間需要不同的氣球比例，查詢時附上全景相片，比單獨提供喜歡的款式更有助規劃。

sections.title: 安裝條件影響最終方案
sections.text: 戶外陽光、風勢與溫度都會影響氣球狀態；室內亦要確認固定方式及消防通道。請先向場地了解佈置規則，再與我們確認支架、進場及撤場安排，展示時間按實際環境評估。

faqs.question: 氣球佈置可以放在戶外嗎？
faqs.answer: 需要按遮蔭、風勢、固定位置和展示時段評估，不能以室內效果或展示時間作保證。

faqs.question: 查詢背景牆需要提供甚麼尺寸？
faqs.answer: 提供可用位置的闊度、高度、深度，以及進場通道和升降機資料，方便評估運送與安裝。

en.title: Custom balloon decoration & backdrops
en.headline: Give your space a new mood.
en.description: Custom balloon decoration and backdrops in Hong Kong, planned around your theme, palette, wording and venue. Explore BoboParty design-to-setup photographs for birthdays, baby celebrations and brand events.

sections.title: From design to the finished setting
sections.text: Explore six design-to-setup examples showing how themed graphics, backdrops, standees and balloons work together. Start with your theme, colours and wording, then adapt the layout to venue dimensions and circulation. Confirm production items, materials and sizes in the agreed plan.

sections.title: Balance colour and scale
sections.text: Start with two or three main colours and consider the walls, lighting and table linen. A tall room and a compact home need different proportions. Wide photographs of the space are as useful as styling references.

sections.title: Plan the installation
sections.text: Sunlight, wind and temperature can affect outdoor balloons. Indoors, fixing methods and clear exits matter. Check the venue rules before confirming supports, access and removal; display life depends on the environment.

faqs.question: Can balloons be installed outdoors?
faqs.answer: The plan depends on shade, wind, anchoring points and display duration. Indoor appearance and longevity cannot be assumed outdoors.

faqs.question: What measurements do you need?
faqs.answer: Share the available width, height and depth, plus doorway and lift information to help assess delivery and installation.

zh-TW.title: 百日宴與寶寶派對
zh-TW.headline: 把成長的第一頁，好好收藏。
zh-TW.description: 為滿月、百日宴與寶寶生日規劃柔和而有層次的派對佈置。BoboParty 與你從色調、名字背景到家庭合照位置逐一整理，配合香港餐廳、宴會廳或家居場地。

sections.title: 名字與色調成為紀念
sections.text: 寶寶名字、日期與家人喜歡的配色，可以成為背景設計的起點。比起堆疊大量元素，保留適量留白能讓合照更清晰，也方便不同組合的家人一起拍照。

sections.title: 為家人留出舒適動線
sections.text: 安排拍照位時，要同時考慮嬰兒車停放、長輩座位與用餐通道。背景位置可避開出入口及繁忙上菜路線，拍照時間亦可配合寶寶休息節奏，減少現場趕急。

sections.title: 先確認宴會場地細節
sections.text: 餐廳的枱數、舞台尺寸、燈光和進場時段都會影響佈置。查詢時提供場地平面圖、希望展示的文字及參考圖片，並在製作前核對名字拼法與日期。

faqs.question: 滿月和百日宴佈置有甚麼分別？
faqs.answer: 設計可按家庭喜好調整，重點是背景文字、日期與聚會規模，並非必須使用某一種固定款式。

faqs.question: 可以加入寶寶名字嗎？
faqs.answer: 可在查詢時提出文字需求；可用字體、尺寸、物料和製作安排需要按方案確認。

en.title: Baby celebrations
en.headline: Celebrate the first chapters.
en.description: Plan a welcoming setting for a baby celebration, hundred-day banquet or first birthday in Hong Kong. Explore gentle colours, name backdrops and family photo areas for your home or banquet venue.

sections.title: Make it personal
sections.text: A name, a date and a family’s favourite colours can guide the backdrop. Leaving visual space around them helps different family groups fit into the same photograph without the decoration competing for attention.

sections.title: Leave room for the family
sections.text: Consider pram parking, seating for older relatives and dining access alongside the photo spot. Keep the backdrop away from busy serving routes and plan photographs around the baby’s rest schedule.

sections.title: Check the venue details
sections.text: Table count, stage dimensions, lighting and access times all affect the plan. Send a floor plan, reference images and proposed wording, and check names and dates carefully before production.

faqs.question: Do different baby milestones need different styles?
faqs.answer: The wording, date and gathering size matter more than a prescribed style. The palette and layout can reflect the family’s preferences.

faqs.question: Can the design include the baby’s name?
faqs.answer: Include your wording in the enquiry. Fonts, dimensions, materials and production arrangements are confirmed with the proposed design.

zh-TW.title: 企業活動與開幕佈置
zh-TW.headline: 讓品牌，在現場被看見。
zh-TW.description: BoboParty 提供香港企業活動與開幕佈置規劃，配合品牌色彩、迎賓位置與合照背景。由公司週年聚會到產品發佈場合，先整理場地限制、製作資料和進撤場安排。

sections.title: 把品牌識別轉化成現場設計
sections.text: 企業活動佈置可由品牌主色、標誌位置和活動訊息開始。迎賓位置著重辨識度，合照背景則要考慮人數與拍攝範圍，避免重要文字被賓客遮擋。

sections.title: 開幕與公司聚會各有重點
sections.text: 開幕佈置需留意門面尺寸、出入口和商場規則；公司聚會則可集中規劃舞台及合照區。不同場景的運送、安裝與撤場條件不同，應在確認設計前與場地管理方協調。

sections.title: 整理一份清楚的活動簡介
sections.text: 請提供活動日期、地點、預計人數、品牌色碼、標誌檔案及製作截止時間。若需要內部審批，可先指定聯絡人及核稿流程，讓修改、製作和現場安排有清晰依據。

faqs.question: 可以配合公司品牌色嗎？
faqs.answer: 可提供品牌色碼及參考圖討論；氣球和印刷物料呈色會因材質與燈光而異，實際選色需要確認。

faqs.question: 商場店舖開幕需要預先確認甚麼？
faqs.answer: 先向管理處確認進場時間、固定限制、通道要求及撤場安排，再提供門面尺寸與現場相片。

en.title: Corporate events & openings
en.headline: Bring your brand into the room.
en.description: Plan corporate event and opening decoration in Hong Kong with BoboParty. Coordinate brand colours, welcome areas and photo backdrops for anniversaries, launches and company gatherings.

sections.title: Translate brand identity into the space
sections.text: Begin with the brand palette, logo placement and event message. Welcome areas need clear recognition, while photo backdrops need enough width for the group and wording positioned above likely obstructions.

sections.title: Match the event format
sections.text: For openings, check the frontage, entrances and building rules. For company celebrations, focus on the stage and photo area. Coordinate delivery, installation and removal conditions with venue management before confirming the design.

sections.title: Prepare a clear brief
sections.text: Share the date, venue, guest count, colour codes, logo files and production deadline. If internal approval is required, agree on a point of contact and artwork review process before scheduling production.

faqs.question: Can decorations match our brand colours?
faqs.answer: Share colour codes and references. Balloon and printed colours vary with material and lighting, so the final selections need to be agreed.

faqs.question: What should we check for a shop opening?
faqs.answer: Ask building management about access times, fixing restrictions, clear walkways and removal, then share frontage dimensions and photographs.

zh-TW.title: 性別揭曉派對佈置
zh-TW.headline: 把驚喜，留在揭曉的一刻。
zh-TW.description: 香港性別揭曉派對佈置，從氣球配色、拍照背景到揭曉位置一起規劃。BoboParty 配合家居、餐廳或私人場地，整理適合家人參與的慶祝場景與現場安排。

sections.title: 先規劃揭曉的焦點
sections.text: 先決定主角站位、揭曉位置和家人觀看方向，再配搭氣球與背景。除了粉藍與粉紅，也可用奶油色、白色或其他喜歡的主色，讓場景更貼近家庭風格。

sections.title: 配合場地與拍攝動線
sections.text: 預留攝影距離及賓客通道，避免揭曉位置緊貼出入口。若安排戶外活動，先確認天氣、固定方式與後備位置；任何揭曉道具都應先向場地確認使用及清理規則。

sections.title: 提前整理保密與流程
sections.text: 查詢時提供日期、場地尺寸、參考配色和揭曉形式。若希望為主角保留驚喜，可先指定一位聯絡人處理揭曉資料，並在活動前確認佈置完成時間及拍攝安排。

faqs.question: 可以在家中舉辦嗎？
faqs.answer: 可以按客廳或拍照角落的可用空間討論，先量度尺寸並確認道具使用和清理安排。

faqs.question: 揭曉道具包含在佈置內嗎？
faqs.answer: 道具、安裝及清理是否包含，需要在查詢時逐項確認，不能只按參考影片推定。

en.title: Gender reveal party styling
en.headline: Make room for the big reveal.
en.description: Plan a gender reveal party in Hong Kong with coordinated balloons, a photo backdrop and space for the reveal. BoboParty helps adapt the setting to your home, restaurant or private venue.

sections.title: Plan the focal point
sections.text: Decide where the parents will stand, where the reveal happens and how guests will gather. Soft neutrals or favourite colours can complement pink and blue for a more personal palette.

sections.title: Coordinate access and photography
sections.text: Leave space for cameras and guests, keeping the reveal away from entrances. For outdoor events, discuss weather, supports and a backup location. Check the venue rules for any reveal props and cleanup.

sections.title: Plan the surprise
sections.text: Share the date, measurements, colour references and preferred reveal format. If the result is a surprise for the parents, designate a contact to coordinate the information and confirm setup and photography timings.

faqs.question: Can we celebrate at home?
faqs.answer: Plan around the available living room or photo corner. Measure the space and confirm prop use and cleanup before deciding the layout.

faqs.question: Are reveal props included?
faqs.answer: Confirm props, installation and cleanup individually in the agreed scope; a reference video does not define what is included.

zh-TW.title: 求婚佈置
zh-TW.headline: 為一句承諾，留一個場景。
zh-TW.description: 香港求婚佈置從兩人的故事出發，整理氣球、文字背景及拍照位置。BoboParty 與你按酒店、餐廳或私人場地條件規劃驚喜，協調進場、完成時間及主角到場路線。

sections.title: 讓設計呼應兩人的故事
sections.text: 選擇有意義的配色、名字或一句想說的話，集中佈置一個拍照焦點。保留主角站位與攝影距離，讓裝飾成為背景，畫面仍然以兩人的互動為中心。

sections.title: 驚喜需要清楚的時間表
sections.text: 提前確認佈置人員的進出方式、完成時間和主角到場路線。如使用酒店房間或餐廳包廂，先取得場地同意並了解固定限制，亦應與攝影師協調隱藏及拍攝位置。

sections.title: 製作前核對每個細節
sections.text: 提供現場照片、尺寸、日期和參考畫面，並逐項核對姓名、日期及求婚文字。確認物料、安裝、運送和清理範圍後，再安排活動當天的聯絡人與撤場時間。

faqs.question: 酒店房間可以佈置嗎？
faqs.answer: 需要先向酒店確認外來人員進場、裝飾固定及清理規則，再按房間空間討論方案。

faqs.question: 需要提前多久查詢？
faqs.answer: 準備時間會因日期、物料和製作要求而不同，確定日期後可盡早查詢，檔期由團隊確認。

en.title: Proposal styling
en.headline: Set the scene for a heartfelt yes.
en.description: Plan a personal proposal setting in Hong Kong with balloons, wording and a photo area. Coordinate hotel, restaurant or private venue access, setup timing and the arrival route with BoboParty.

sections.title: Start with your story
sections.text: Choose meaningful colours, names or a short message and build one photo focal point. Leave space for the couple and the camera so the decoration frames the interaction.

sections.title: Give the surprise a schedule
sections.text: Confirm supplier access, completion time and the arrival route. Get permission and fixing guidance for hotel rooms or private dining areas, and coordinate camera positions with the photographer.

sections.title: Check every detail
sections.text: Send venue photographs, measurements, the date and references. Proofread names, dates and wording, confirm materials and delivery, installation and cleanup, then agree on a day-of contact and removal time.

faqs.question: Can you decorate a hotel room?
faqs.answer: Check supplier access, fixing and cleanup rules with the hotel before planning a layout for the room.

faqs.question: How early should I enquire?
faqs.answer: Lead time depends on the date, materials and production requirements. Enquire once the date is known; availability is confirmed by the team.

zh-TW.title: 婚禮佈置
zh-TW.headline: 把兩人的故事，帶到婚禮現場。
zh-TW.description: 香港婚禮佈置由迎賓區、氣球裝飾到合照背景逐一規劃。BoboParty 配合婚禮色調、場地尺寸及宴會流程，整理適合酒店、餐廳或私人場地的佈置方向。

sections.title: 從迎賓與合照區開始
sections.text: 迎賓區是賓客接觸婚禮的第一個場景，合照背景則需預留不同人數的拍攝空間。選色可呼應禮服、花藝及場地裝潢，讓視覺連貫而不搶去新人焦點。

sections.title: 佈置時間配合婚禮流程
sections.text: 將進場安裝、攝影、迎賓與宴會開始時間一起規劃。酒店及餐廳可能有固定位置、消防通道和卸貨限制，應先與場地管理方確認，再落實尺寸及安裝方式。

sections.title: 核對文字與其他供應商安排
sections.text: 製作前確認新人姓名、日期與背景文字，並提供場地平面圖及桌數。若另有花藝或攝影供應商，可先交流擺設位置，避免遮擋通道、燈光和拍攝範圍。

faqs.question: 小型婚宴也可以做佈置嗎？
faqs.answer: 可以先集中在迎賓台或合照位置，按場地尺寸、人數和預算討論合適的佈置範圍。

faqs.question: 撤場是否包括在內？
faqs.answer: 運送、安裝、撤場和租借物料的歸還安排，需要在確認方案時逐項核對。

en.title: Wedding styling
en.headline: Bring your story to your wedding day.
en.description: Explore wedding styling in Hong Kong, from welcome areas and balloon details to photo backdrops. BoboParty helps coordinate your palette, venue dimensions and reception schedule.

sections.title: Start with the welcome and photo areas
sections.text: The welcome area introduces the celebration, while the backdrop needs space for different group sizes. Coordinate colours with clothing, flowers and the venue to keep the couple at the centre.

sections.title: Coordinate the wedding schedule
sections.text: Plan installation alongside photography, guest arrival and the reception. Check fixing positions, exits and unloading restrictions with the venue before confirming dimensions and installation methods.

sections.title: Confirm wording and supplier layouts
sections.text: Proofread names, the date and backdrop wording, and share the floor plan and table count. Coordinate with florists and photographers to keep routes, lighting and camera views clear.

faqs.question: Can you style a small wedding reception?
faqs.answer: Focus on a welcome table or photo spot, and discuss a scope that fits the space, guest count and budget.

faqs.question: Is removal included?
faqs.answer: Confirm delivery, installation, removal and any hired-item returns individually when agreeing the plan.
